projects.title: A Century of Colours
projects.description: Among over 50 proposals, we won the public competition for designing the symbol celebrating the centenary of Tirana as the capital city. We made it colorful, because that is exactly how we feel it.

data.content: City of Tirana was preparing to celebrate its centenary as a capital of Albania, with a bang. For that, they needed a symbol to mark the entire year's festive events.
They invited everyone to apply, and let the public vote for the best piece of work. We won with a bang, and below is the reason why.

Since many visitors couldn't experience Tirana's centennial due to the pandemic, we designed a mobile museum that traveled Albanian cities in Kosova and the region, making this
anniversary an attraction outside the capital city itself.
Other cities welcomed the mobile museum, which traveled through a centory of colourful history of Tirana, displaying the most iconic photos that marked this time period.

We organised a karaoke concert with old Tirana songs for the people of the capital, the first of its kind ever, inviting everyone to sing the most beautiful to have ever been sung over
the 100 years. The most famous evergreen songs were featured and loved by the audience.
